description: The navigation family covers four sub-patterns wired to the exos theme: (1) the application top navbar (`.navbar.navbar-expand`, with primary/secondary bars and an exos `.nav-item-logo` slot), (2) side / list-group navigation (`.side-navigation` whose active item gets a primary left border), (3) pagination — Bootstrap `.pagination` plus the exos `.pagination-footer` toolbar wrapping page links with per-page and showing-text controls, and (4) dropdown menus (Bootstrap `.dropdown` re-shadowed by the theme, with the exos `.nav-dropdown` item styling). Pick a sub-pattern via the `variant` axis. Several theme refinements are scoped to compound selectors (e.g. `.navbar.top-primary-navigation`) and are applied by combining classes in markup rather than as standalone modifiers.

always: Wrap primary navigation landmarks in a <nav> element (or role="navigation") with a descriptive aria-label.
Mark the current page/item with aria-current (`page` for nav links, `true` for the active list-group/dropdown item).
On a dropdown toggle, set aria-expanded to reflect open/closed state and aria-haspopup where appropriate.
never: Do not treat `top-primary-navigation`, `top-secondary-navigation`, `striped-list`, or `solid-list` as standalone classes — they only take effect when combined with `.navbar` / `.list-group` (use them together in markup).
Do not omit aria-current on the active navigation item.
Do not nest interactive controls inside a .page-link other than the link/button itself.

a11y: Each navigation region needs a landmark: <nav aria-label="Main"> for the primary bar, <nav aria-label="Pagination"> around .pagination.
Set aria-current="page" on the active .nav-link / .page-link and aria-current="true" on the active .list-group-item.
Disabled .page-item links should carry tabindex="-1" and aria-disabled="true".
Dropdown toggles must expose aria-expanded and link the menu via the menu/aria semantics.

variant.description: Which navigation sub-pattern to build. Pick one.

navbar.note: Application top bar. Combine with `.navbar-expand` and, in markup, `.top-primary-navigation` / `.top-secondary-navigation` for the two exos bars. Contains `.nav-item` / `.nav-link`; logo slot is `.nav-item-logo`.

side-nav.note: Vertical nav rendered as a `.list-group`; the active `.list-group-item` gets a primary-colored left border.

pagination.note: Bootstrap built-in page navigation made of `.page-item` > `.page-link`.

dropdown.note: Bootstrap built-in dropdown; theme adds box-shadow to `.dropdown-menu`. Use `.nav-dropdown` on the menu for the exos nav item styling.

navbarExpand.description: Navbar horizontal expansion (apply only to the navbar variant).

always.note: Bootstrap built-in; keeps nav items inline at all breakpoints.

dark.note: Dark navbar surface; the exos primary bar overrides this with --exos-navigation-background-color when combined with top-primary-navigation.

pageState.description: State of an individual pagination item (.page-item).

active.note: Marks the current page; also set aria-current="page" on its .page-link.

disabled.note: Non-interactive page item (e.g. prev on the first page).

listDensity.description: Density of list-group based navigation (side-nav / list-group variant).

no-y-padding.note: Exos-specific; removes top/bottom padding on list-group items.

root.note: Primary navbar example root; for other variants swap to .pagination / .list-group / .dropdown.

children.note: Exos logo slot inside the top navbar.
Set aria-current="page" when this is the active item.
Add .active and aria-current="true" on the current item.
Set aria-expanded to reflect open state.
Add .nav-dropdown on the menu for exos nav item styling.
